audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart disagreed with itself and with the packet in four rows: Level 1 read Irelia (packet: Skill), Levels 4-5 read Skill (packet: Irelia), First item read Skill (packet: Irelia), 2+ items read Irelia (packet: Kayle). The prose already said the opposite of the chart in every one of those rows — whys[0] calls level 1 even, whys[3] and whys[5] call 4-5 and first item a takeover, whys[6] says she outscales hard.
audit.why: A 53.59% Emerald+ win rate over 612 games with a scaling opponent is an early-lane win that ends at two items. The chart was inverted at exactly the rows the prose describes.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 3, 5 and 6 flipped in both layers as one atomic group, with ratings moved to match (5/10 at level 1, 8/10 at 4-5 and first item, 3/10 at 2+ items).

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment was tracked all page long without its cooldown, and Celestial Blessing — her actual laning sustain on a flat 15s — was never mentioned at any spike.
audit.why: Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1 and 120s at rank 2. That is a two-and-a-half-minute punish window after she burns it, which is the single most concrete piece of timing in the lane and the page omitted it.
audit.corrected: 160s rank-1 cooldown written into spikes[1] and wants.you[1]; Celestial Blessing's 15s sustain and the Grievous Wounds answer added to mid and wants.foe[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: Radiant Blast (Q) is never named anywhere on the page, so the reader is told to 'respect her poke' with no idea what it is. Starfire Spellblade (E) is an auto-attack reset on a 6-8s cooldown and free to cast, and that wind-up is the burst tell — absent. Celestial Blessing's heal is absent, so the Executioner's Calling line in report[8] has no stated reason.
audit.why: Radiant Blast slows and strips resistances at 900 range on a 12s rank-1 cooldown — it is what makes her poke actually hurt and what sets up her E burst. The E reset is the moment to step back; the page instead points at the cast.
audit.corrected: Radiant Blast named with its slow, resist shred and 12s cooldown in early; the Starfire Spellblade auto reset added as the step-back tell in wants.you[0]; Celestial Blessing's 15s heal given as the anti-heal reason in mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2] and mid both promise to dive a 'still-meleed Kayle' at first item.
audit.why: Kayle's passive grants attack range as she levels, and the first-item timing is not safely assumed to be melee. The kit file does not state the level numbers, so nothing about level 6 or 11 range is asserted either — the advice is rewritten to key off the ultimate's cooldown instead of her form.
audit.corrected: Form-dependent claims replaced with cooldown-keyed language in spikes[2].

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Divine Judgment's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your takeover window: she has no Divine Judgment yet, so E-stun into a Bladesurge reset every time she steps up to last-hit and deny her the gold.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Divine Judgment's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King completes — force fights while Divine Judgment sits on its 160-second cooldown.

edits.before: Her R is Divine Judgment (invulnerability), not damage — bait it out, then re-engage with a fresh E and Bladesurge resets before it comes off cooldown again.
edits.after: Her R is Divine Judgment (invulnerability), not damage — bait it, then re-engage on a fresh E. At 160 seconds rank 1 you get two more full windows before it returns.

edits.before: Your Triforce spike with full Bladesurge reset uptime and Ionian Fervor armor shred makes you a lane tyrant — dive a still-meleed Kayle under tower repeatedly here.
edits.after: Your Triforce spike with full Bladesurge reset uptime and Ionian Fervor armor shred makes you a lane tyrant — dive her under tower on every Divine Judgment cooldown you bait out.

edits.before: Bait Divine Judgment with a feint or your W (Defiant Dance) damage reduction, then commit your real all-in once her invulnerability is on cooldown
edits.after: Bait Divine Judgment with a feint or a fake commit, then bring the real all-in — it is 160 seconds at rank 1, so the next wave cycle is free

edits.before: Land E (Flawless Duet) to stun her, then chain Bladesurge resets off the wave for Ionian Fervor armor-shred DPS a melee Kayle can't survive
edits.after: Step back on the Starfire Spellblade (E) wind-up, not the cast — that auto reset is her burst; then E-stun and chain Bladesurge resets through the wave

edits.before: Survive the early levels with safe melee-form last-hits and stall until her Divine Judgment ult and ranged form arrive
edits.after: Heal the chip off with Celestial Blessing (W) every 15 seconds and stall to Divine Judgment and her range upgrades

edits.before: Kayle is one of the worst level-1s in the game — a melee auto-attacker with no dash and no Divine Judgment until 6, so the early window is entirely yours. You're a bit soft at 1 yourself with only Q, so farm with Bladesurge tip-resets off the wave and don't throw a free trade into her short-range poke for nothing. The moment you hit level 3 you have the full E (Flawless Duet) stun into Bladesurge-reset combo — that's your first kill threat, and a still-meleed Kayle has zero answer to a landed stun before her ultimate.
edits.after: Kayle is one of the worst level-1s in the game — no dash and no Divine Judgment until 6, so the early window is yours. You're soft at 1 with only Q, so farm Bladesurge resets off the wave and don't trade into Radiant Blast (Q) for nothing: it slows, strips your resists and is back every 12 seconds at rank 1. The moment you hit level 3 you have the full E (Flawless Duet) stun into Bladesurge-reset combo — that's your first kill threat, and she has no answer to a landed stun before her ultimate.

edits.before: This is your takeover window and the whole game hinges on it. With Ionian Fervor stacking and your Bladesurge cooldown resetting off E-marked targets, you out-trade and all-in a melee Kayle every time she steps up to last-hit — E-stun, dash in, and let your passive armor shred melt her. At 6 her R is Divine Judgment: pure invulnerability, not damage, so bait it with a fake commit or tank a beat under W's (Defiant Dance) damage reduction, then re-engage once it's down. Every level she survives is a level closer to her ranged spike, so do not let her farm in peace.
edits.after: This is your takeover window and the whole game hinges on it. With Ionian Fervor stacking and Bladesurge resetting off E-marked targets, you all-in her every time she steps up to last-hit — E-stun, dash in, shred. Celestial Blessing (W) heals her back every 15 seconds, so buy Executioner's Calling the moment trades start going long. At 6 Divine Judgment is pure invulnerability, not damage: bait it with a fake commit, then re-engage once it's down. Every level she survives is a level closer to her range spike, so never let her farm in peace.

notes: Four level-chart rows were inverted against the packet and against this page's own prose; all four flipped as one matched group with ratings. The page repeatedly called Kayle melee at the first-item timing — her passive grants attack range as she levels and the kit file gives no level numbers, so that claim was removed rather than replaced with a number I cannot verify from the kits.
